title: A helper that returns true or false
prompt: Write `is_even`, which returns true when its parameter is even. `solve` returns is_even(n).
hints: Functions whose names start with is_ usually return a bool; the comparison itself can be the return value.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.what: The remainder after dividing a by b.
